mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are 69 degrees with mainly clear skies over Harriet Park and a new moon in the sky.

The city has shared important notices for the upcoming elections, and residents should also be aware that road construction on Highway M begins August 18, which will include traffic shifts and temporary closures of the Kwik Trip driveway.
We have plenty to do with Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, and Hop Haus Trivia all happening today, plus live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow.

Looking at the weekly report, on August 8, local officers assisted the Dane County Sheriff's Office by using a drone to locate a suspect involved in an in-progress burglary who had fled into a corn field.
Satisfy your sweet tooth with today's Devil's Food Cake flavor; the store is currently closed but will open at 10 AM to serve you.
